sinastria.fbS1: ### 🌟 1. The Alchemy and Identity of the Couple
sinastria.fbFraseGlobal85: An exceptional resonance: you feel like a shared destiny, where energies amplify each other.
sinastria.fbFraseGlobal70: Solid foundations and a connection that, consciously nurtured, can last and grow over time.
sinastria.fbFraseGlobal55: Real chemistry and connection, with areas that will ask for work. A bond that teaches as much as it unites.
sinastria.fbFraseGlobal40: A school: what you build here requires effort and depth, but it leaves a mark.
sinastria.fbFraseGlobal0: Paths that cross from difference, not from lack.
sinastria.fbCompuesta: 🪐 As a team, your composite chart draws its own energy: the Sun in {solSigno}{solCasa} sets your shared direction; the Moon in {lunaSigno}{lunaCasa} holds the emotional climate of the bond; Venus in {venusSigno}{venusCasa} colors how you love each other; and Mars in {marteSigno}{marteCasa} ignites how you desire each other.
sinastria.fbCompuestaAsc: The composite Ascendant in {signo} is the face you show the world as a couple.
sinastria.fbRegalo: The greatest gift you give each other is your strength in **{factor}** ({score}/100).
sinastria.fbAprendizaje: 🌱 The lesson that will make you grow most as a couple lies in **{factor}** ({score}/100).
sinastria.avisoSimbolico: This compatibility analysis is a symbolic interpretation. Take it as a mirror for reflection, not as a deterministic forecast.
sinastria.factorFase_quimica_facilidad: Attraction and passion flow naturally. There is a magnetism felt in the body and an intimacy that needs no words.
sinastria.factorFase_quimica_matiz: Chemistry is present but with nuances: there is desire and attraction, yet they are best nurtured consciously so they endure over time.
sinastria.factorFase_quimica_intenso: The attraction is intense and magnetic, and the tension (Venus-Mars / Mars-Mars / Mars-Pluto square or opposition) adds friction: it excites, though it can sometimes spark arguments. Channeled well, it makes the bond more alive.
sinastria.factorFase_quimica_desafio: Physical chemistry is subtle or requires work. Passion is not the main engine of the relationship, but it can be awakened with conscious gestures of connection and affection.
sinastria.factorFase_emocional_facilidad: The emotional connection is deep and steady: you feel seen, held and understood in your innermost self. A shared emotional home.
sinastria.factorFase_emocional_matiz: The emotional connection is good, with moments of great attunement and others of misunderstanding. Recognizing each other's emotional languages strengthens the bond.
sinastria.factorFase_emocional_intenso: The emotional connection is intense and deep: feeling floods everything, sometimes with ups and downs. Learning to regulate the shared flow stabilizes the bond.
sinastria.factorFase_emocional_desafio: The emotional connection requires work. It is not a lack of love but of attunement: each of you processes emotions differently, and that can create shared loneliness.
sinastria.factorFase_mental_facilidad: The mental affinity is remarkable: you share a language and a way of processing the world. Talking together is a shared, stimulating pleasure.
sinastria.factorFase_mental_matiz: Communication flows naturally, though there are nuances to polish. Mental affinity is a good base to grow from.
sinastria.factorFase_mental_intenso: Your minds stimulate each other intensely: vivid dialogues and sometimes sparks — even arguments. Turning intellectual friction into learning enriches the couple.
sinastria.factorFase_mental_desafio: Your communication styles differ: you process information differently. Patience and active listening are the key to dialogue.
sinastria.factorFase_espiritual_facilidad: There is a deep spiritual and values attunement: you share a vision of life that connects you beyond the everyday.
sinastria.factorFase_espiritual_matiz: The spiritual attunement is subtle but present: it is cultivated through shared practices, values and moments of meaning.
sinastria.factorFase_espiritual_intenso: The spiritual bond is intense and transcendent, almost karmic. It can become idealized; anchoring the magic in reality protects you.
sinastria.factorFase_espiritual_desafio: Your spiritual visions and sense of meaning differ. It is not a lack of depth but of code: respecting each other's path is key.
sinastria.factorFase_estabilidad_facilidad: The bond is held with solidity: there is commitment and firm foundations for the long term — a sense of "this lasts".
sinastria.factorFase_estabilidad_matiz: The stability is good, with foundations that require maintenance and dialogue about expectations to be sustained.
sinastria.factorFase_estabilidad_intenso: The relationship is intense and commitments may feel restrictive to one and necessary to the other. Talking about the pace balances it.
sinastria.factorFase_estabilidad_desafio: Stability requires effort: the structure of the bond may feel rigid to one and unstable to the other. It takes awareness and voluntary commitment.
sinastria.factorFase_valores_facilidad: You share lifestyle and affective values: you love similarly and expect the same, which gives the relationship coherence.
sinastria.factorFase_valores_matiz: Your values and love styles have differences: you agree on the essentials but differ in how you show affection and what to expect. Talking about it brings harmony.
sinastria.factorFase_valores_intenso: The way you love is intense and passionate, but with differences in how you show love. Aligning expectations avoids misunderstandings.
sinastria.factorFase_valores_desafio: Your values and love styles (Venus) differ: how you love and what you expect may not fit. An honest dialogue is needed to align your way of loving.
sinastria.factorFase_transformacion_facilidad: The shared intensity is well channeled: you have the capacity to transform together, generating deep evolution without harm.
sinastria.factorFase_transformacion_matiz: Transformation is present, but it requires managing intensity and boundaries so as not to overflow.
sinastria.factorFase_transformacion_intenso: The bond is intense and transformative: Pluto tension (square/opposition) does not subtract — it is fire that can purify or burn. Setting healthy boundaries is essential.
sinastria.factorFase_transformacion_desafio: The power-and-transformation axis is delicate: dynamics of control, jealousy or fear of loss may appear. Awareness and clear boundaries are the key.
sinastria.factorFase_compromiso_facilidad: The commitment axis (House 7 / Descendant) is strongly activated: personal planets sit near the Descendant, which favors building the "us".
sinastria.factorFase_compromiso_matiz: The commitment axis is present, though it requires dedicating time and intention to building the "us".
sinastria.factorFase_compromiso_intenso: Commitment is activated with intensity: House 7 is charged with energy, both to unite and to create tension in the couple. Managing the "us" is the challenge.
sinastria.factorFase_compromiso_desafio: The commitment axis is barely activated: there are few connections near the Descendant, so the "us" must be built with more intention and dedication.
sinastria.consejo_compromiso: Nurture commitment and the partnership axis: make time to build your "us".
sinastria.consejo_transformacion: Manage intensity: set healthy boundaries and channel shared power without control or fear.
sinastria.consejo_valores: Align your values and love style: talk about what you expect and how you want to love.
sinastria.factorDesc_compromiso: Planets near the commitment axis (7th House / Descendant).
sinastria.factorDesc_transformacion: Intensity, shared power and the capacity to transform together.
sinastria.factorDesc_valores: Love style and values: how you love and what you expect from each other.
sinastria.leyendaSector: each bar is an area of the relationship (chemistry, emotional, mental, spiritual, stability, values, transformation, commitment).
sinastria.panelNota: Each bar is an area of the relationship. Green flows · Yellow nuances · Amber intense (with friction) · Red needs work.

sinastria.leyendaOrbe: the exactness of the angle between two planets. Under 2° = a very strong, unavoidable connection.
sinastria.leyendaDimension: each aspect feeds one of the 5 radar areas (chemistry, mental, emotional, spiritual, stability).
sinastria.leyendaGlobal: weighted average of the 5 dimensions. Not a verdict, but a snapshot of the resonance.
sinastria.leyendaCasas: one person's planets fall into the other's houses, activating that area of their life.
sinastria.localIntro: Local synthesis based on cross aspects.
sinastria.noGuardadas: You haven't saved any synastry yet.
sinastria.notaOrbe: An orb below 2°00 means the connection is exceptionally strong and ineludible.

quimicaPasion.Alta: The physical chemistry and passion between you are intense. There is a magnetism felt in the body, an attraction that needs no words. Sensory intimacy is a ground where you flow naturally.
quimicaPasion.Media: There is a sensual chemistry that, while present, is not overwhelming. There is attraction and desire, but it needs to be consciously cultivated and expressed to last over time.
quimicaPasion.Baja: Physical chemistry is subtle. Passion is not the main engine of the relationship, but it can be activated with conscious gestures of connection and affection.
quimicaPasion.MuyBaja: Sensual chemistry is faint. The connection is not based on passion, but on other planes. It is important to recognize this without judgment and nurture intimacy through other channels.

afinidadMental.Alta: Mental affinity is extraordinary. You share a language, a way of processing the world. Dialogues are fluid, stimulating and enriching. Conversing is a shared pleasure.
afinidadMental.Media: Communication flows naturally, though there are nuances to polish. You grasp the essentials, but details sometimes need clarification. Mental affinity is a good foundation to grow.
afinidadMental.Baja: Mental affinity has nuances. It is not that you do not understand each other, but that you process information differently. Patience and active listening are key to dialogue.
afinidadMental.MuyBaja: Communication styles are very different. What is clear to one is confusing to the other. It requires conscious effort of translation and mental empathy.

conexionEmocional.Alta: The emotional connection is deep. You feel seen, held and understood in the most intimate way. There is a language of silences and gestures that needs no words. It is a shared emotional home.
conexionEmocional.Media: The emotional connection is good, with moments of great resonance and others of misunderstanding. You love each other, but sometimes speak different emotional languages. Recognizing that strengthens the bond.
conexionEmocional.Baja: The emotional connection requires work. It is not a lack of love, but of resonance. Each processes emotions differently, which can create moments of shared loneliness.
conexionEmocional.MuyBaja: The emotional worlds are very different. What is a need for one is excess for the other. It requires much compassion and a willingness to understand the other without imposing your own language.

sintoniaEspiritual.Alta: Spiritual resonance is notable. There is a sense of shared destiny, as if the souls recognized each other. You share deep values and a transcendent vision of life.
sintoniaEspiritual.Media: Spiritual resonance is subtle but present. There are moments when you feel something greater than yourselves, but it is not something that fills the whole relationship. It is cultivated with shared practices.
sintoniaEspiritual.Baja: Spiritual resonance is faint. It is not that it does not exist, but that it expresses through different channels. Each connects with the transcendent in their own way, and that is valid.
sintoniaEspiritual.MuyBaja: Spiritual visions are very different. It is not a lack of depth, but of code. It requires respecting the other's path without imposing your own.

estabilidadFuturo.Alta: The stability of the bond is notable. There is a commitment that holds with solidity, a sense of "this lasts". Saturn and the foundations of the relationship are firm.
estabilidadFuturo.Media: Stability is good, with moments of solidity and others of adjustment. The relationship has foundations, but requires conscious maintenance to last over time.
estabilidadFuturo.Baja: Stability requires work. It is not that the relationship is fragile, but that commitments can feel restrictive to one and necessary to the other. It requires dialogue about expectations.
estabilidadFuturo.MuyBaja: Stability is a challenge. The structure of the bond can feel rigid to one and unstable to the other. It requires much awareness and voluntary commitment to build foundations.

compat.85: This relationship has an exceptional resonance ({score}%). {label}. It is a bond that feels like a shared destiny, where energies amplify each other in most dimensions.
compat.70: This relationship has a solid affinity ({score}%). {label}. There are firm foundations and a connection that, with awareness, can be sustained and grow over time.
compat.55: This relationship has an attraction with nuances ({score}%). {label}. There is chemistry and connection, but also areas that will ask for work. It is a bond that teaches as much as it unites.
compat.40: This relationship is a formative challenge ({score}%). {label}. It is not an easy connection, but it is a school. What is built here is built with effort and depth.
compat.0: This relationship follows diverging paths ({score}%). {label}. It is not a lack of value, but of natural resonance. What is shared is shared from difference.

sinastria.desgloseNota: The global % is the weighted sum of 8 factors (weight × score).
sinastria.cartaCompuestaDesc: The composite chart is the midpoint of each planet pair: the "relationship" as its own entity.
sinastria.casa7Desc: The Descendant (ASC + 180°) marks commitment. Planets of one person near the other's Descendant activate the partnership.
sinastria.factorDesc_quimica: Physical attraction and passion between you.
sinastria.factorDesc_emocional: Connection of feelings and mutual care.
sinastria.factorDesc_espiritual: Deep values and sense of destiny.
sinastria.factorDesc_elementos: Harmony between the elements of your charts.
sinastria.factorDesc_casa7: Planets near the commitment axis (7th House).
sinastria.factorDesc_compuesta: The relationship as its own entity (composite chart).
sinastria.consejo_quimica: Feed the spark: leave room for desire, surprise and play between you.
sinastria.consejo_emocional: Practice listening and emotional safety: say what you feel and validate the other.
sinastria.consejo_mental: Improve communication: talk calmly and listen actively before arguing.
sinastria.consejo_espiritual: Share a practice or values: connect on what gives meaning to your life.
sinastria.consejo_estabilidad: Strengthen the foundation: set clear expectations, routines and long-term agreements.
sinastria.consejo_elementos: Appreciate temperament differences: balance fire, earth, air and water.
sinastria.consejo_casa7: Tend to commitment and the partnership axis: make time to build your "us".
sinastria.consejo_compuesta: Know each other as a unit: define a shared project or vision for the relationship.
sinastria.netoDisclaimer: General balance of all aspects. The factor breakdown shows the day-to-day of the relationship better.
sinastria.horaDesconocida: ⚠️ Approximate or unknown birth time in at least one chart: only planet-to-planet aspects are shown (no houses, Ascendant or House-7 Commitment), and the composite chart is limited to planets. For maximum precision, calculate both charts with the exact time.
sinastria.disclaimerScore: Indicative index: it summarizes how the two charts dialogue; the real relationship depends on you both.

onboarding.paso1_texto: Discover the exact position of the planets at your birth with surgical precision. Explore your houses, aspects, and the elemental balance of your natal chart.
onboarding.paso2_texto: Perform 1-card, 3-card, or full Celtic Cross readings. Each card is interpreted with its deep meaning and its relationship to your question.
onboarding.paso3_texto: The ancient Chinese oracle accompanies every Tarot reading. Toss the virtual coins, get your hexagram, and discover the mutant lines that mark your future.
onboarding.paso4_texto: Generate deep, personalized analyses of your readings and birth chart with oracular artificial intelligence. Your guide to self-knowledge.
onboarding.paso5_texto: Tap any underlined technical term (cards, planets, signs, houses, aspects) to see a short, clear description. An easy way to learn while you explore your oracle.
onboarding.paso6_texto: Compare two saved birth charts and discover the couple's compatibility: passion, mind, emotion, spirit and stability, with a radar chart and AI analysis.
